pascal:1640.author: Blaise Pascal
pascal:1640.locus: Paris: February 1640 (Broadside published under the initials B. P.)
pascal:1640.note: Seminal printed broadside announcing the Mystic Hexagram theorem, projective definitions of pencils of lines, and the program for the complete projective study of conic sections.

desargues:1639.author: Girard Desargues
desargues:1639.work: Brouillon project d'une atteinte aux événemens des rencontres du cône avec un plan
desargues:1639.note: Foundational text of synthetic projective geometry introducing points at infinity, involutions, and pencil ordonnances, acknowledged by Pascal as his direct inspiration.

apollonius:conics.author: Apollonius of Perga
apollonius:conics.note: Classical Hellenistic benchmark of conic section theory synthesized and generalized projectively by Pascal.

pappus:synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus:synagoge.note: Contains the two-line Hexagon Theorem (VII.139) that forms the degenerate archetype of Pascal's Hexagrammum Mysticum.

steiner:1832.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner:1832.work: Systematische Entwicklung der Abhängigkeit geometrischer Gestalten von einander
steiner:1832.note: Establishes the 20 Steiner points formed by 3-by-3 concurrencies of the 60 Pascal lines.

pluecker:1830.author: Julius Plücker
pluecker:1830.work: Über ein neues Übertragungsprincip in der analytischen Geometrie
pluecker:1830.locus: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle's Journal), 1830
pluecker:1830.note: Proves that the 20 Steiner points lie four-by-four on 15 Plücker lines.

kirkman:1850.author: Thomas Penyngton Kirkman
kirkman:1850.locus: Cambridge and Dublin Mathematical Journal, Vol. 5, pp. 281–283, 1850
kirkman:1850.note: Discovers the second set of 60 3-fold concurrencies of Pascal lines (Kirkman points).

chasles:1865.author: Michel Chasles
chasles:1865.note: Comprehensive nineteenth-century synthetic treatise establishing conic cross-ratio observer invariance.

smith:1929.author: David Eugene Smith (ed.)
smith:1929.locus: New York: McGraw-Hill, 1929 (English translation of Essay on Conics by Dr. Frances Marguerite Clarke, pp. 326–330)
smith:1929.note: First complete English translation of Pascal's 1640 broadside with historical apparatus.
